ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) localized pixel distributions concentrated in linear and circular patterns.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive network of white linear streaks across both lobes; dense, textured high-intensity clusters located at the extreme lateral tips; isolated white circular focal spots on the medial surface of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a wide angle; the vertex is partially occluded by high-intensity water spray pixels at the base of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing boundary characterized by high-frequency, varying-amplitude jagged serrations; significant notches and peaks are visible on both lobes, particularly towards the outer edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the posterior-distal margin, terminating in blunt, thickened lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, high-contrast, three-dimensional textured clusters at the lateral tips (barnacle colonization); isolated white circular scars present on the inner right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Abundant, multi-directional high-contrast white linear filaments (rake marks) crossing the black background pixels across the entirety of both visible lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring across the ventral surface; heavy distal barnacle encrustation; irregular notches along the trailing edge indicating past physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme lateral edges of the fluke exhibit a thickened, cauliflower-like texture of high-intensity pixels distinct from the smoother fluke surface.
